## Current objective
Fix `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py` so customers who have already paid do not receive dunning reminders. Router splitting remains paused/superseded by this priority bug; enterprise onboarding is also pending.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- Dunning scheduler: `ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`
- Scheduler recurrence module: `src/ledgerly/scheduler/recurrence.py`
- Payments sandbox: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`
- `https://sbx-pay-a.ledgerly.dev` is superseded and shut down; do not use.
- Organization: `org_acme_industries`
- Plan/currency: `enterprise-annual` / `USD`
- Database: `./migrations/enterprise`, version `0042`
- Seed: `./seeds/acme-enterprise-v3.json`, conflict key `external_id`
- Billing/welcome emails: `billing@acme.example` / `admin@acme.example`
- Never manually modify license text or attribution in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- Never enable a Celery task without Locust proving ≥400 successful executions/second and zero timeouts.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Increasing the SQLAlchemy pool size to 50 caused staging lock contention and deadlocks.
- Using the shut-down `sbx-pay-a` endpoint returns stale fixtures.
- Manually editing third-party license/attribution text is prohibited.
- Router splitting is paused, not a failed approach.

## Plan and progress
- [done] Fix recurrence DST handling and add regression coverage.
- [done] Run scheduler/billing tests: 31 passed.
- [done] Run full suite: 186 passed, 2 skipped, 1 unrelated legacy-rounding failure.
- [done] Add currency rounding tests; 6 passed, including high-precision and default-places cases.
- [in progress] Inspect and fix paid customers receiving dunning reminders.
- [pending] Resume router-split commits.
- [pending] Complete enterprise onboarding.
- Next exact command: `sed -n '1,260p' ledgerly/dunning/scheduler.py`

## Recent work
Enterprise organization creation, migration to version 0042, and seeding completed successfully. Recurrence timezone behavior was fixed and verified, including post-transition wall time. Currency rounding coverage was expanded after identifying an unrelated invoice fixture failure. Dunning scheduler inspection has not yet begun.

- FastAPI dependency defaults in call arguments are superseded by `Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]`.
